methods.name: public IkeSecurityParameterIndex allocateSpi(InetAddress sourceAddress) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Get a new IKE SPI and maintain the reservation. * *

If this instance is constructed by a spiGenerator, this method will try to allocate SPI * once for the return value of spiGenerator#nextLong. Otherwise, this methods will try multiple * times until it finds an avalaible IKE SPI. * * @return an instance of IkeSecurityParameterIndex.
